summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called HRS-7535 in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, a condition where the body cannot properly process sugar. The study looks at adults aged 18 to 75 who still have high blood sugar despite taking metformin and making lifestyle changes. Participants will receive either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real treatment. This trial is sponsored by Shandong Suncadia Medicine Co., Ltd.
